question: Can a species' route-specific chorus footprint measured only in 2001-2007 predict how deeply that species spreads across stops when it is newly active on the wetter side in 2008-2015?
validation_pairs: Construct matched wetter-drier pairs using only eligible 2008-2015 runs within State x RouteNumber x RunNumber; require all ten physical SiteIDs to be identical within each pair.
unit: validation matched pair x wet-route-new species

early_template.opportunity_sites: The validation pair's ten current SiteIDs that were sampled in >=1 eligible 2001-2007 run of the same route-season stratum.
early_template.minimum: At least 8 opportunity SiteIDs and at least 2 eligible early runs in the stratum.
early_template.early_strong_breadth: Fraction of opportunity SiteIDs at which the species reached CallingIndex 2-3 at least once during 2001-2007.
early_template.early_any_breadth: Fraction of opportunity SiteIDs at which the species had any CallingIndex >0.
early_template.early_route_frequency: Fraction of eligible early runs in which the species occurred anywhere on the route.
early_template.focal_species: Species must have occurred somewhere on that route-season in 2001-2007; no validation-period outcome is used to define the template.

outcomes.wet_k: Number of validation wet-survey stops occupied by the route-new species.
outcomes.wet_strong_k: Number of validation wet stops with CallingIndex 2-3.

primary_model.formula: third_plus_depth ~ z_early_strong_breadth + c_rain_contrast + z_early_strong_breadth:c_rain_contrast + early_route_frequency + temperature_difference + day_of_year_difference + year_gap + C(species) + C(State) + C(RunNumber)
primary_model.centered_rain: c_rain_contrast is centered within the validation sample.

secondary: Repeat with wet_k, spatial_depth=wet_k-1 and wet_strong_k.
Report breadth x rain interaction without a separate success gate.
Repeat primary in same-observer validation pairs and exact-consecutive-year validation pairs if their prefixed gates pass.
minimum_gate: >=500 validation pair-species observations, >=150 routes, >=20 species and SD(early_strong_breadth)>=0.10.
interpretation: Support is a non-overlapping temporal validation that historical route-scale species-site footprint predicts later activation depth.
The analysis still conditions on wet-side recruitment and therefore does not explain activation probability.
It does not identify movement, abundance, continuous occupancy, reproductive success or a physiological mediator.
No causal rainfall claim is authorized.
